visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair wearing a light-colored button-up shirt sits at a wooden desk in front of a laptop. He gestures with his hands while looking directly at the camera in a room with soft indoor lighting and a red wall in the background. A small black cartoon character icon is visible on the bottom left of his laptop screen. (2) The scene transitions to an outdoor shot of a modern office building with blue glass windows and a prominent 'UMC' logo. Green trees frame the bottom of the building under a cloudy sky. (3) The man returns to the screen, gesturing actively. A new shot shows the 'tsmc' logo in red on a gray industrial-style building. (4) The man continues his narration, and a blue 'Industrial Technology Research Institute' (ITRI) logo appears as a graphic overlay beside him. A cartoon avatar of a woman with black hair briefly appears on the screen in a circular frame. (5) Stock footage shows a diverse group of people sitting around a table in a bright office, looking at papers and tablets. The man reappears at his desk, followed by a grayscale close-up of two people in suits shaking hands. (6) A scene of a large crowd of people outdoors holding up purple and white signs during a protest or public event is shown. (7) Back to the man at the desk, gesturing broadly. The camera then cuts to a close-up of hands counting a thick stack of US dollar bills. (8) The man holds a movie poster titled 'A CHIP ODYSSEY' (造山者) against a blue background with a globe. He later appears in a different indoor setting with neon bar lights and bottles behind him, holding a smartphone and pointing at the camera.

(2) A short, medium-pitched female voice interrupts with a single question, followed by a 'pop' sound effect. The male voice continues explaining history, his tone becoming informative yet engaging. (3) The BGM maintains a steady tempo as the male narrator lists company names and dates; a subtle digital 'whoosh' sounds as graphics appear. (4) As the narration shifts to the movie recommendation, the speaker's pitch rises slightly with excitement. A 'cartoon crying' sound effect accompanies an emotional part of his speech. (5) The video ends with a high-energy call to action in a slightly different acoustic space, with the music swelling slightly before a final hard cut.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Historical Context -> Logical Pivot (Economy/Patriotism) -> Recommendation/Promotion -> Call to Action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate the audience on the historical factors behind Taiwan's semiconductor industry success, specifically citing US technology transfer and the patriotic motivation of the 1970s. It uses this historical narrative to seamlessly promote the movie 'A Chip Odyssey' (造山者) and encourage viewers to participate in a ticket giveaway.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The narrator explicitly recommends watching the film, shows the poster, and offers a ticket giveaway in the final scene.
